subject.title: [Bug] Cyclic dependency deadlock during plugin resolution

question: Should `requiresPlugins` remain a presence-and-warning contract, or should OpenClaw introduce an inter-plugin activation-order dependency graph with cycle rejection?
rationale: Current documentation does not promise dependency-ordered plugin bootstrap, while the suggested topological sort would create a new compatibility-sensitive plugin contract.

options.title: Keep Presence-Only Semantics
options.body: Require a current-main reproduction through an existing supported path and otherwise clarify that plugins must not rely on inter-plugin activation order.

options.title: Add Dependency Ordering
options.body: Define required versus optional edges, ordering, missing-dependency behavior, cycle diagnostics, compatibility, and tests as a new manifest contract before implementation.

recommendation.title: Keep Presence-Only Semantics
recommendation.body: Require a current-main reproduction through an existing supported path and otherwise clarify that plugins must not rely on inter-plugin activation order.

likelyOwner.reason: The most directly relevant history is the existing loader reentry-hardening work on the alleged failure boundary.
